subtitle: Barton's Tunkillia drilling wrap and GoldArc's Leonora South acquisition headline a busy corporate news day
lead: Twelve confirmed announcements from 14 watchlist names crossed in the past 24 hours, out of a watchlist of 91 tickers. Barton Gold leads, having completed 39,000m of Phase 2 resource upgrade drilling at Tunkillia, taking combined Phase 1 and Phase 2 metres to 57,653m across 520 RC and diamond holes, ahead of a Pre-Feasibility Study with GR Engineering Services targeted for the first quarter of CY2027.
watch_items: GoldArc's binding agreement to acquire the Niagara West and North tenements from Regener8 Resources requires shareholder approval, targeted via an EGM by 30 September 2026, with the related share issue (up to 39,610,389 shares) expected on 2 October 2026.
Great Boulder's revamped MD and KMP pay structure, including performance rights linked to production start at Peak Hill, requires shareholder approval at the AGM in November 2026.
Evolution lodges its FY26 Financial Report and Appendix 4E pre-opening on 19 August 2026, with a conference call at 10.30am Sydney time the same day.
day_in_brief:
Corporate and administrative news dominated the session, with no quarterlies among the 12 confirmed announcements. Barton Gold's completion of 39,000m of Phase 2 drilling at Tunkillia was the most substantive operational update, alongside GoldArc's two related announcements: a binding tenement acquisition from Regener8 Resources adjacent to its Leonora South project, and the associated share issue of up to 39,610,389 shares as consideration. Many Peaks Minerals appointed Jamie Byrde as CFO effective 26 October 2026, while Great Boulder Resources lifted its Managing Director's remuneration package following an independent review. Substantial holder movements featured heavily: State Street Corporation became a substantial holder in Kingsgate Consolidated (5.01%) while reducing its stake in West African Resources to 6.48%, and Citigroup briefly became then ceased to be a substantial holder in Predictive Discovery within a single day. Norwest Minerals completed its underwritten entitlement offer, raising A$1.89 million in full. Saturn Metals confirmed compliance following its placement of 63,783,443 shares at A$0.40 each. Evolution Mining set 19 August 2026 as the date for its FY26 results briefing, reporting FY26 production of 715koz of gold and 66kt of copper. Benz Mining's monthly CDI count rounded out the day's routine filings.

summaries.heading: Barton completes 39,000m Phase 2 resource upgrade drilling at Tunkillia
summaries.body: Barton Gold has finished Phase 2 resource upgrade drilling at Tunkillia, taking combined Phase 1 and Phase 2 drilling to 57,653m across 520 RC and diamond holes. The program targets upgrading the S1 and S2 optimised pit mineralisation to JORC Indicated, with the highest-value S1 material to Measured category. A Pre-Feasibility Study is underway with GR Engineering Services, targeting publication in the first quarter of CY2027.

summaries.heading: GoldArc to acquire Niagara tenements, extending Leonora South
summaries.body: GoldArc has signed a binding agreement to acquire the Niagara West and North tenement package from Regener8 Resources, adjacent to its Leonora South project near Kookynie, WA. Upfront consideration is A$1.5 million in GoldArc shares at A$0.07 each, escrowed for six months, plus two contingent payments of A$500,000 each tied to reaching 100,000oz and 250,000oz JORC Mineral Resources at 1.5g/t Au or better. The ground sits along strike from GoldArc's Orion (26,409oz Au) and Sapphire (21,605oz Au) resources, with historical intercepts up to 70.52g/t Au from 7m. Completion requires shareholder approval, targeted via an EGM by 30 September 2026.

summaries.heading: Many Peaks appoints new Chief Financial Officer
summaries.body: Many Peaks Minerals has appointed Jamie Byrde, a Chartered Accountant with over 20 years' resource sector finance and governance experience, as CFO effective 26 October 2026 on a 0.8 FTE basis with a base salary of A$264,000 per annum. He receives 500,000 options exercisable at A$1.00 and 500,000 performance rights tied to a feasibility study and financial close for the Ferké Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire. The appointment comes as Many Peaks progresses its scoping study and drilling at Ferke.

summaries.heading: Goldarc to issue shares for seven prospecting licences
summaries.body: Goldarc Resources plans to issue up to 39,610,389 shares to Regener8 as consideration for seven prospecting licences, comprising a 21,428,571-share upfront payment valued at A$1.5 million plus two milestone tranches of 9,090,909 shares each valued at A$500,000. Milestone shares price at the 5-day VWAP prior to vesting, with a floor of A$0.055 per share. The issue requires shareholder approval at a meeting expected on 30 September 2026, with securities to be issued on 2 October 2026, and upfront shares subject to six months voluntary escrow.

summaries.heading: Great Boulder revamps MD and KMP pay structure
summaries.body: Following an independent remuneration review, the Board has lifted Managing Director Andrew Paterson's base salary to $414,000 plus superannuation, unchanged in three years. He is also eligible for an STI of up to $178,600 (40% of TFR) tied to 1.5Moz and 1.0Moz resource targets at Side Well and Peak Hill, and an LTI of up to $178,600 in performance rights linked to production start at Peak Hill and a mining lease grant at Mulga Bill. Performance rights require shareholder approval at the AGM in November 2026.

summaries.heading: State Street Corporation becomes substantial holder in Kingsgate
summaries.body: State Street Corporation and its subsidiaries became a substantial holder in Kingsgate Consolidated on 3 August 2026, with a relevant interest in 13,316,701 ordinary shares representing 5.01% voting power. The holding is largely index and custodial in nature, spread across State Street Global Advisors entities and associated securities lending arrangements.

summaries.heading: State Street reduces WAF stake below 6.5%
summaries.body: State Street Corporation and subsidiaries' voting power in West African Resources moved from 7.50% (85,763,431 shares) to 6.48% (74,067,174 shares) following changes effective 3 August 2026. The change is a passive, custodial-style movement across its managed and lending entities rather than a market transaction disclosed in the notice.

summaries.heading: Norwest completes underwritten entitlement offer
summaries.body: Norwest Minerals has completed its non-renounceable entitlement offer, raising the full A$1.89 million after underwriters took up 164,042,640 shortfall securities. Entitlement and additional applications totalled 106,289,585 shares for A$744,342.41. Funds will go towards further exploration and development of the Bulgera Gold Project.

summaries.heading: Citigroup drops below substantial holder threshold in PDI
summaries.body: Citigroup Global Markets Australia and related entities ceased to be a substantial holder in Predictive Discovery on 3 August 2026, a day after becoming one. The change reflects securities lending and ordinary market dealings, including a decrease of 102,607,125 shares held by Citigroup Global Markets Australia. No operational implications for the company.

summaries.heading: Benz Mining routine CDI count for July 2026
summaries.body: Benz Mining reports 291,933,473 CDIs on issue at end of July 2026, up 64,031 from the prior month via net transfers of ordinary shares into CDI form. Unquoted ordinary shares fell to 46,961,590. Options and performance rights on issue were unchanged.

summaries.heading: Evolution sets date for FY26 results briefing
summaries.body: Evolution will lodge its FY26 Financial Report and Appendix 4E pre-opening on 19 August 2026. Managing Director Lawrie Conway and CFO Fran Summerhayes will host a conference call at 10.30am Sydney time that day, with a listen-only audio stream and analyst Q&A dial-in available. FY26 production was 715koz of gold and 66kt of copper, with Group operating mine cash flow of $3,394 million at an All-in Sustaining Cost of $1,717 per ounce.

summaries.heading: Saturn Metals completes placement with compliance notice
summaries.body: Saturn Metals has issued 63,783,443 fully paid ordinary shares at A$0.40 per share under the placement announced on 29 July 2026. The notice, lodged under section 708A(5)(e) of the Corporations Act, confirms the shares were issued without a disclosure document and that the company has complied with its Chapter 2M and continuous disclosure obligations.
